## Why measure before building the economic core

The corrected source passes SDK/revision fixtures, including actual wrapper
action -> production invalidation -> fresh capture -> continuation. Its eight
current-engine construction games nonetheless produce 9,368 fuel suspensions
versus original940, 233deaths versus74, 953banked versus5,457, and1/8wins
versus4/8. Candidate WASM is
`b87eb8b98c9f2b70827515a16f7bbca22cbab874c72bb931a1b290d74d4846d6`.
All eight have0VMfaults/0loggedSDKerrors. Those outcomes do not reject the
combined economic/action design, but the action implementation is not ready.

Before these games, PC froze Swirl both sides rounds1-160 for mechanism
selection, with12rounds context. Neither prefix contains Recall or dash-before-
walk. Missing coverage remains incomplete, not proof of universal inactivity.
There is no permission to expand those scouts adaptively or run another
strength panel. Source scaling alone does not prove the cause of suspension.

Relevant exact parent source facts:

- `LiveBackend::capture` converts full-map visible/occupancy boards, acquires
  enemy/ability data, maps visible camps by repeated `std::find` over static
  members, queries relevant state and appends every member to `Scene.camps`.
- `Features` in `select_plan` computes49local tile features; current exposure
  scans all scene camps and enemies, response scans enemies again. Effects
  also inspect group members; candidate count is bounded417, not measured fuel.
- `query` samples dispatch/fuel before and after a wrapper, and wrappers can
  contain multiple raw imports. Query count is not raw import count or fuel.
- The older campaign profiler had material observer effects even after
  deferring output. OFF was byte-identical; ON was diagnostic evidence only.
  Treat that as a requirement and limitation here, not a reason to skip
  attribution. Do not restore the old profiler bot over this source.

## Default-OFF, completely removable instrumentation

Use `src/phase_profile.h` with exactly these activation declarations:

```cpp
#ifndef PPFX_ENABLED
#define PPFX_ENABLED 0
#endif
#ifndef PPFX_PHASE_MASK
#define PPFX_PHASE_MASK 0x7ffu
#endif
```

OFF preprocesses every hook, object, counter, helper call and output operation
out of production gameplay. No disabled sampling, changed evaluation order,
branch, extra getter, new static initialization or altered exception handling.
The PC requires OFF WASM byte-identical to the exact parent hash above before
building/running ON. Scope-preservation tests should compare mechanically
stripped/normalized tokens with parent, but are not a substitute for that hash.
Do not alter all source formatting or unrelated test files.

Number scope bits0-8 in this order:

| Scope | Exact intended span |
| --- | --- |
| recovery | Whole `recover()` call / actual controller execution |
| prepare | `LiveBackend::prepare`, including its static initialization/cache work |
| capture | Whole `LiveBackend::capture` |
| self_geometry | Capture entry through self flags, owned visible/occupancy arrays and origin validation; stops before enemy list acquisition |
| members | Capture visible-camp acquisition, position mapping, relevance/state queries and final camp-scene construction/checks |
| plan | Whole `select_plan`, including feature/effect construction and candidate arithmetic |
| defense | Whole `LiveBackend::defend` |
| issue | Whole `LiveBackend::issue`, including its actual preflight/action wrapper |
| play_turn | Whole `Bot::play_turn`; preserves all early returns |

If exact lexical subscopes need braces, document them and preserve reference
lifetimes and evaluation order. No sampling inside each candidate, tile, member
or `query` invocation. A runtime mask is unnecessary: preprocessor/compile-time
mask bits must eliminate disabled scopes. No SDK handles stored by profiler.

Collect scope entries whose sampled entry round is1..100. Sample game round
and `fuel_remaining()` at entry/exit. Store same-round **inclusive** fuel delta,
count, min/max and a small fixed histogram. Preserve crossed-round count and a
bounded sample of start/end round/fuel and scope identity. Do not derive a
cross-round total using an assumed per-round allowance: first turns have a
different allowance and a long scope can cross several rounds. Nested inclusive
costs cannot be summed as exclusive costs. Unexpected exception/early return
must close/label the scope through a nonthrowing safe mechanism; sampler
failures must not mask the underlying game exception.

Sampling can itself straddle a round. Use a bounded round/fuel/round coherence
check and mark an inconsistent sample invalid; do not label mismatched values
a same-round delta. Include that sampling overhead in the stated observer
effect. Distinguish normal returned Status counters from Halt/SDK/other
exception exits; a return-only hook cannot count all incomplete/stale paths.
Avoid shortening existing self/state/reference lifetimes when delimiting
self_geometry: explicit scope closure is preferable to moving declarations
or changing evaluation order.

No allocation, sorting, string formatting, stdout, actor-ID query or expanding
per-call event FIFO in collection. Fixed per-instance arrays suffice. Count
dropped crossed examples/overflow explicitly. No arbitrary heap growth to make
the report appear complete. Close admission after100; scopes already admitted
may finish afterward and retain their actual crossing. Do not emit while any
admitted scope remains active.

Additional aggregate context belongs only at existing result/construction
boundaries, inside enabled hooks. Reuse current values; do not add SDK queries
or rescan members to calculate profiler counters:

- prepare/capture outcomes ready/incomplete/stale/deferred and cache reuse;
- scene cell count, static member count, visible camp count, mapped count,
  relevant known/alive/awake count (accumulate during existing loop), enemies;
- capture `queries` count and min/max, labeled guarded wrapper counts;
- returned plan raw candidates/risk rejections/effect unknowns/actions;
- actual recovery results/moves/dashes/recalls/captures.
- available fuel at recovery entry (reuse the scope's sampled value, with a
  fixed histogram), cold member/terrain initialization versus warm reuse.
  Upstream turn work must not be silently attributed to recovery/capture.

Count entry and completion separately so an unfinished scope or a missing drain
cannot masquerade as a cheap completed call. No new public game API or hidden
data is needed. All measurements remain actor-local.

## Deferred, actor-tagged output

Output is forbidden at game rounds<=100. After100, from an explicit safe point
at the start of `play_turn`, drain at most2fixed records per invocation only
when current fuel>=40,000, after checking current round and no active admitted
scope. Tag each record with actual actor ID, source/profile version, phase and
collection window. Acquire actor ID only for draining, never on each hot hook.
Use one compact unambiguous text/JSON line format, cumulative scope/context
summaries, crossed-example overflow counts, and one actor completion trailer.
Once drained, never print another collection summary for that actor. No output
inside recovery or an exception handler. A match ending before drain has
missing evidence; do not print earlier to fill it.

Scope closure must remain possible after the window closes; do not falsely
complete a still-running admitted scope at round100. Natural death/respawn may
give a drain opportunity but must not reset profiler identity, totals or safety
state. Profiler does not change priorities, action permissions, routes,
thresholds, query limits, reserves, SDK observation revision or static cache.
